# Weights & Biases

Written from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) to match the DESIGN.md spec. `tools/catalog.py` did not write this file. `make design-md` needs a catalog.json entry for `wandb`, and this capture does not edit catalog.json. Do not treat a later `make design-md` as having produced this file until that entry exists.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` marketing theme with aliases resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth. It also holds the `light` Forge signed-out theme.

## Overview

Good for: a dark MLOps marketing page on ink and teal, plus a light Forge sign-in.

Captured 2026-11-21, public site, signed out. Themes: dark, light.

Weights & Biases is an MLOps platform. This package is a public Playwright capture of wandb.ai/site on 2026-11-21, signed out. The app host wandb.ai redirects to a CoreWeave Forge login wall. Marketing pages are dark. The Forge login and signup screens are light.

## Colors

The roles below are the marketing dark theme, which is the surface this capture photographed most. The front matter then lists colour tokens from the `dark` set. Forge cobalt and the light login screen live in tokens.json under `light` and are not the colours exported here.

- **primary (#00AFC2):** `dark.color.text.accent`
- **neutral (#1A1C1F):** `dark.color.bg.page`
- **on-surface (#FFFFFF):** `dark.color.text.primary`
- **on-surface-variant (#ADB0B5):** `dark.color.text.muted`

No surface swatch was read on the marketing page. The page background is the ink. Do not invent a card surface from the screenshot.

## Typography

6 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack. Families: Source Sans 3, Source Serif 4.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Source Sans 3 is the UI face on both surfaces. Source Serif 4 is the marketing display face. These are commercial faces. The tokens name them. The files are not in this package.

## Layout

No spacing scale in tokens.json. Control heights are on the component tokens: Weave button 60px, Request demo 50px, contact field 42px.

## Elevation & Depth

No shadow tokens were captured. The Weave button computed box-shadow was none. Depth on the marketing page comes from the ink page and the raised field colour.

## Shapes

Corner radii from `core.radius`: `sm` 3px, `md` 4px, `lg` 8px.

## Components

3 components from the `dark` component tokens, keeping height and radius. Button fill and text colour are not stored as component colour tokens. The Weave fill is the gradient in the README.

Measured states, crops and the full inventory: [components.md](components.md), [components](components), [style-guide.html](style-guide.html).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need the Forge light theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value. It says what was not read.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots. They are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file as if `make design-md` owned it. That command cannot rewrite it until catalog.json has a `wandb` entry.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the teal gradient for the marketing call to action.** The Weave button is `linear-gradient(270deg, #10bfcc, #0097ab)` with ink text, 8px radius, and uppercase Source Sans 3. See [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
- **Use cobalt for the Forge primary button.** Log in is `#0541e9` on white, 4px radius, 32px tall. See [screenshots/login-light-default.png](screenshots/login-light-default.png).
- **Keep the marketing page on ink.** Body background is `#1a1c1f`. Display type is Source Serif 4. Nav links are `#00afc2`. See [screenshots/home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
- **Do not submit the signup form from this capture.** Signup offers Google, GitHub, and Microsoft as well as email. No account was created. See [screenshots/signup-light-default.png](screenshots/signup-light-default.png).
- **Do not follow LOG IN and keep capturing.** That URL is a login wall. Record it and stop. See [login-review.json](login-review.json).

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Marketing and Forge are two products. `dark` is the marketing site. `light` is the Forge signed-out screen. Do not paint a marketing page with Forge cobalt.

The Weave button fill is a gradient. `dark.color.action.primary` is only the end stop.

`core.typography.label` line height is the Elementor accent line height, 18px, not a computed line height on the button.

The code sample's font was not read. There is no code type token.

Spacing is not a published scale. Control heights live on the component tokens.

The menu panel's own background colour was not stored. Do not invent one from the screenshot.

WordPress preset colours are in the stylesheets and are not product roles. They were left out.

The contact screenshots have the published support address painted over with the page ink. The docs link beside it is still the live page.
